mcqs.keyword: Seven basic necessities and poverty support
mcqs.question:
With reference to the seven basic necessities and the Zero Poverty P4 principle under the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision, consider the following statements:
Statement A: The seven basic necessities include housing, sanitation, tap water, clean cooking fuel, electricity, digital connectivity and DBT.
Statement B: Zero Poverty P4 envisages the top 10% supporting the bottom 20% through philanthropy and mentorship.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The seven basic necessities are housing, sanitation, tap water, clean cooking fuel, electricity, digital connectivity and DBT, while Zero Poverty P4 envisages support from the top 10% to the bottom 20% through philanthropy and mentorship.

mcqs.question: During Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu’s Singapore visit, which Andhra Pradesh initiative and institutional proposal was Google invited to participate in?
options: The Sanjeevani healthcare project and AI/cloud centres in universities
A logistics parks and supply-chain city project
A Centre of Excellence in Amaravati
A branch or satellite campus in Amaravati
mcqs.explanation: Google was invited to participate in Andhra Pradesh’s Sanjeevani healthcare project and to establish AI and cloud centres in universities. The logistics parks proposal was associated with YCH Logistics Group, while the Centre of Excellence and satellite campus proposals involved other organisations.

mcqs.question: Under which programme were 260 model panchayats along the Godavari included in Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.explanation: The 260 model panchayats along the Godavari were included under the Viksit Bharat–Gram Gaurav programme. Namami Gange was the model for the Mission Godavari Clean Project, while “Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu” was the Pushkaram theme.
